question: Indian Classical dancer Kumkum Dhar was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for her contribution to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sangeet Akademi Award is one of the most prestigious awards in the field of performing arts in India.**
 
• ​ Some of the other** classical dance forms in India include Odissi, Bharatanatyam, and Manipuri.**
 
• Kumkum Dhar is a renowned Kathak dancer who has made significant contributions to the art form.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi (The National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama in English) is the national-level academy for performing arts set up by the Government of India.
 
• It was set up by th**e Indian education ministry on 31 May 1952 **and became functional the following year, with the appointment of its **first chairman, Dr. P. V. Rajamannar.**
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the first President of India, inaugurated it on 28 January 1953 in a special function held in the Parliament House. The academy's Fellowship and Awards are considered very prestigious.
 
• In India, it functions as the headquarters of performing arts.
 
• It presents the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards which is the highest Indian recognition given to performing/practicing artists
 
• **Kathak is a classical dance form that originated in northern India and is characterized by fast footwork, intricate hand gestures, and facial expressions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi **is a classical dance form that **originated in the state of Odisha and is characterized by fluid movements and intricate footwork.**
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance form that originated in the **state of Tamil Nadu** and is characterized by grace, precision, and storytelling.
 
• **Manipuri **is a classical dance form that originated in the **northeastern state of Manipur** and is characterized by its use of intricate hand movements and graceful movements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Puruskar**

 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama, bestows the Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar.
 
• It is the highest honor bestowed to practicing artists in India.
 
• Prior to 2003, the prize came with a citation, a tamrapatra, an angavastram (a shawl), and Rs. 50,000.
 
• Since 2009, the cash prize has been increased to ₹1,00,000.
 
• The awards are presented in the performing arts categories of music, dance, theatre, other traditional arts, puppetry, and contribution/scholarship.
